thread:
evan: Noticed spike of connector handshakes failing for Private tenants during CP pressure windows. Two patterns: TLS verify errors after rotator, and explicit 502/503 backpressure.

maya: For backpressure we should return a machine-readable 'retry_later' plus a server-suggested retry_after_seconds so connectors can back off instead of failing fast.

rick: Agree. Minimal handshake schema proposal: status=(ok|retry_later|fatal), code int, reason string, retry_after_seconds int optional, cp_min_compat string. Keep it tiny.

ev an: connectors must include an idempotency token header (x-conn-idempotency) so CP can dedupe retries. Token TTL ~60s. Also attach attempt count header to help debugging.

maya: Policy: never auto-fallback to regional-relay unless tenant has both `relay_fallback_allowed=true` and `egress_ip_flex=true`. Default off for Private. UI should show a confirmation and egress IP change warning.

ui: We'll add a Console toggle with an explicit interstitial and the list of affected egress IPs. API will require an explicit field.

rick: Telemetry: emit metric connector.handshake.result with labels tenant, outcome, reason, cp_version. Alert on sustained fatal >0.5% over 15m or retry_later >3% over 5m.

infra-bot: Rotator v2 rolled to canary regions 2026-05-10T03:21:00Z. Observed 0.7% retry_later spike.

ev an: Plan: I'll draft RFC addendum with payload, backoff pseudocode, idempotency header, and a 10-tenant canary rollout. CC @maya @rick.

maya: Thanks. Include sample connector snippet and console mockups.
